verdict.rationale: Dover documents a first-party Bulk actions feature that applies the same change to many candidates at once instead of editing each profile, which directly matches the story's core. The evidence is a single docs sentence with no detail on which actions are supported, how many items can be selected, or whether bulk operations can be run through the API or MCP tools. Missing for 10: an enumerated list of supported bulk actions and their limits, documented bulk endpoints in the API or MCP, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Bulk actions let you apply the same change to many people at once, instead of opening each profile.
